title: Can not read from S3 with AssumedRoleCredentialProvider after upgrade from EMR serverless 6.9 to 7.5
question:
I have a pyspark script that reads data from S3 in a different AWS account, using AssumedRoleCredentialProvider , it is working on emr serverless 6.9 but when I upgrade to EMR Serverless 7.5 it fails with the following errror

 org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.impl.InstantiationIOException: `s3://MY_BUCKET/MY_FILE.txt': Class org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.auth.AssumedRoleCredentialProvider instantiation exception java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: software/amazon/awssdk/thirdparty/org/apache/http/client/utils/URIBuilder (configuration key fs.s3a.aws.credentials.provider): software/amazon/awssdk/thirdparty/org/apache/http/client/utils/URIBuilder

Here is the minimal working example contains configurations for Spark Session

from pyspark.sql import SparSession

region='eu-west-1'
role_arn='TO_BE_ASSUMED_ROLE_ARN'

spark_session = (
SparkSession.builder
.config("spark.hadoop.fs.s3.impl", "org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.S3AFileSystem")
.config("spark.hadoop.region", f"{region}")
.config("spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.aws.credentials.provider","org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.auth.AssumedRoleCredentialProvider")
.config("spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.assumed.role.arn",role_arn)
.config("spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.assumed.role.sts.endpoint", f"sts.{region}.amazonaws.com")
.config("spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.assumed.role.sts.endpoint.region", region)
.config("spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.assumed.role.credentials.provider", "org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.auth.IAMInstanceCredentialsProvider")
.enableHiveSupport()
.getOrCreate()
)
spark.read.text(“s3://MY_BUCKET/MY_FILE.txt”).show()

any support on that error, I spent a lot of time on it, even I am not able to find the missing class's jar to add it.

Thanks

I expect the code to work on EMR Serverless 7.5 the same way it was working on 6.9
answer:
instantiation exception java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: software/amazon/awssdk/thirdparty/org/apache/http/client/utils/URIBuilder

NoClassDefFoundError almost always means there is some version mismatch between different libraries being used. EMR 7.5 might need an updated version of awssdk you are using. Update your library versions. Most likely awssdk version but you can do trial and error of other libraries based on EMR docs or taking AWS team help.
